messages:
dana: FYI ticket from AcmeCorp — new staging tenant shows API token in Console but every request returns 403. tenant=acme-staging project=acme-stg-01. Customer says token appears under Console > API Keys.

maria: Can you paste the exact curl + response they see?

dana: ```
$ curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer key_abc123\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/text/generate -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}' 
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"message\":\"API key not valid for project acme-stg-01\"}
```

kai: :thinking: Possible provisioning mapping bug. Last week we saw seed creds land in an internal project when OIDC claim parsing failed. Can someone check the internal provisioner logs for acme-staging?

dana: Log snippet from provisioner:
```
provisioner.INFO created_key id=key_abc123 tenant=acme-staging project=internal-test-proj assigned_by=oidc-provisioner ref=claim-9876
provisioner.INFO attempt_bind project=acme-stg-01 subject=svc-provisioner result=denied reason=orgpolicy:allow-service-bind=false
```

dana: Customer says they never saw `internal-test-proj` — console shows the token but their project dropdown is `acme-stg-01`.

jenna: Assigning this. @opsbot can you run the reconciler for tenant `acme-staging` and report any mismatches?

opsbot: reconciler: job queued ref=job-555
opsbot: reconciler: completed; moved 1 key(s) from `internal-test-proj` -> `acme-stg-01` (ref job-555)

maria: Nice. Dana, please ask customer to retry the same curl.

dana: Customer retried — still 403. New trace from auth-service:
```
auth-service.ERROR key=key_abc123 project=acme-stg-01 allowed=false reason=missing-role-binding subject=serviceAccount:svc-provisioner:key_abc123
```

kai: OK that explains it. Provisioner created the key in the right project now but the service account binding wasn't created because org policy blocked the automatic bind earlier. We need to create the binding manually, then confirm.

jenna: Manual bind command (internal admin-only):
```
admin-cli grant-role --project acme-stg-01 --subject \"serviceAccount:svc-provisioner:key_abc123\" --role \"projects/api-invoke\"
```

opsbot: grant-role: succeeded (op id op-998)

maria: Can customer try again?

dana: Customer retried and now receives 200 OK. :tada: They reported normal responses and token works.

dana: Closing the ticket after customer confirmation. Root cause summary I'll add to the ticket: provisioner fell back to `internal-test-proj` on OIDC claim mismatch; org policy prevented auto-binding so the key ended up unbound even after reconciliation.

kai: I'll open an engineering issue (INF-2026) to: 1) detect org-policy denies earlier and surface warning in console, 2) add a retry path that attempts binds after reconciliation, 3) log clearer audit info.

maria: Also recommend we add a short blurb in onboarding docs about org policies that block service account binds.

dana: @support-bot please create a customer goodwill credit (small token credit) for AcmeCorp for the trouble.

support-bot: Credit request created: CR-9876, assigned to billing-team.

jenna: Thanks team. Will follow up with postmortem once INF-2026 is triaged. :thumbsup:
